input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Something for Everybody"?

documents.text: Something for Everybody (Devo album) Something for Everybody is the ninth studio album by the American new wave band Devo. It was originally released in June 2010 (being their first studio album in two decades, since 1990's "Smooth Noodle Maps") on their original label Warner Bros., and was their first issued on that label since their sixth studio album "Shout" in 1984. The album was recorded between July 2007 and mid-2009, at Mutato Muzika, in West Hollywood, California. The album is the last Devo album to feature Bob Casale, who died in February 2014.
